name: HELM
description: Stanford's Holistic Evaluation of Language Models measuring 7 metrics (accuracy, calibration, robustness, fairness, bias, toxicity, efficiency) across 16 core scenarios. Includes specialized long-context and safety variants.
creator: Stanford CRFM

dataset.source: 16 core scenarios covering diverse tasks, 7 evaluation metrics

notes: Living benchmark. 96% standardized coverage across 30+ models. Includes HELM Safety (5 safety benchmarks) and HELM Long Context variants.
